title: Perfect completeness of the composed system
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ use parameter $K$. If an input word $w$ and proof $p$ make $V$ accept with probability $1$, then the composed three-query system accepts $w$ with the composed proof with probability $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean proof-checking system $V$ with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$
